description.value: Watson Lake Trailhead provides access to the Watson Lakes Trail in Seven Sisters Provincial Park, a wilderness park situated between Terrace and Hazelton off Highway 16. The trail is an easy 3 km walk passing three small lakes with picnic sites, suitable for families and novice visitors, and offers fishing (rainbow trout), swimming in summer, and exceptional wildlife viewing including grizzly bears, mountain goats, and wolverines. Cyclists touring Highway 16 may find it a worthwhile detour into one of BC's more remote and scenic wilderness areas.
